responsibility: Contains the autogenerated documentation-URL table for the main x86 target options declared in `gcc/config/i386/i386.opt`. It maps option spellings such as ISA enables, ABI selectors, tuning flags, and x86-specific code-generation controls to `UrlSuffix` entries in the GCC manual, while also marking unresolved or multiply-matched options, so GCC’s generated option metadata can point users at the correct manual sections.
